title: Open base change of a composite structure-module direct image
statement:
theorem nonempty_open_base_change_structure_module_iso
    {Y L : Scheme.{u}} (j : Y ⟶ L) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (U : L.Opens) {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ U.toScheme) :
    let g := f ≫ U.ι
    let B : L.CommAlgebraSheaf := Under.mk
      (⟨g.c⟩ : L.sheaf ⟶ (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} g.base).obj X.sheaf)
    let t := j ∣_ U
    let Z := CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback f t
    let p := pullback.snd f t ≫ (j ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
    let C : Y.CommAlgebraSheaf := Under.mk
      (⟨p.c⟩ : Y.sheaf ⟶
        (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} p.base).obj Z.sheaf)
    Nonempty (restrict B.toModule j ≅ C.toModule)

source.place: Tags 008C and 0094; open-base-change section calculation in Tag 0EY6

proof.text: Pull back f along t=j restricted to U. Paste that cartesian square with the square defining t, obtaining IsPullback i p (f followed by U inclusion) j, where i is the first projection and p the second projection followed by W inclusion. Because t is an open immersion, i is an open immersion. The square gives i image (p inverse-image T)=g inverse-image (j image T).

For each open T use the structure presheaf isomorphism along this equality followed by i.appIso to compare sections. Apply the square commutation identity to appLE maps to identify the scalar actions. Multiplicativity of the ring section maps gives linearity. The appIso_hom_naturality identity, together with presheaf functoriality and uniqueness of maps between opens, gives naturality. ModuleCat.isoMk, PresheafOfModules.isoMk and fullyFaithfulForget give the sheaf module isomorphism. No finite, etale, depth or Noetherian hypothesis is used, and empty opens are included.
